title: Request metadata tests do not assert the metadata
reasoning: Both tests set user-agent and remote address headers and are named/described as verifying request metadata capture, but they only assert that the event exists. A regression that drops IP/user-agent capture would still pass, so the intended behavior is not protected.
recommendation: Assert the exact metadata fields populated by Event.create_event, or rename/remove these tests if metadata capture is intentionally outside this suite's contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current assertions stop before checking any metadata values; the comments explicitly defer to implementation details instead of validating behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Post with HTTP_USER_AGENT and REMOTE_ADDR, fetch the created event, and assert the expected stored user-agent/IP fields match the request.
minimumFixScope: Update the two request metadata tests to validate the concrete Event metadata contract.
